title: Display & Audio Configuration
description: Optimize your HP OMEN's display settings for the best visual experience and configure audio for immersive gaming and entertainment.

steps.title: Display Settings Overview
steps.content:
Configure your display for optimal visual quality and gaming performance.

**Key Display Settings:**

• **Refresh Rate** - Higher rates provide smoother visuals. Location: Settings → Display → Advanced display. Use highest available (144Hz, 165Hz, or 300Hz).

• **Resolution** - Native resolution provides the sharpest image. Location: Settings → Display → Display resolution. Use native (usually 1920x1080 or 2560x1440).

• **HDR** - Enhanced colors and contrast on supported displays. Location: Settings → Display → HDR. Enable if your display supports HDR.

• **Night Light** - Reduces blue light for comfortable viewing. Location: Settings → Display → Night light. Schedule for evening hours.

infoBox.title: Tip
infoBox.content: Higher refresh rates provide smoother visuals but may reduce battery life. Consider using 60Hz when on battery for productivity tasks.

steps.title: Display Color Calibration
steps.content:
Use Windows built-in calibration tool for accurate colors.

**Calibration Steps:**

1. **Open Display Color Calibration** - Search for "Calibrate display color" in Windows

2. **Adjust Gamma** - Follow on-screen guide. Circles should blend into background when correct

3. **Set Brightness & Contrast** - Use monitor OSD or Windows settings. Shirt should be barely visible, X should be crisp

4. **Adjust Color Balance** - Move sliders until gray bars appear neutral. Remove any color tint from gray tones

5. **Save Calibration** - Click Finish and compare before/after. Create a color profile for your display

infoBox.title: Pro Tip
infoBox.content: For professional work requiring color accuracy, consider using a hardware colorimeter like X-Rite i1Display or Datacolor Spyder.

steps.title: Audio Configuration
steps.content:
Configure audio settings for the best gaming and entertainment experience.

**Spatial Sound:**
Right-click speaker → Spatial sound
• Windows Sonic (Free, good for gaming) ✓ Recommended
• Dolby Atmos (Premium, cinema quality)
• DTS Headphone:X (Premium, gaming focused)

**Sample Rate & Bit Depth:**
Sound settings → Device properties → Advanced
• 24-bit, 48000 Hz (Studio quality) ✓ Recommended
• 24-bit, 96000 Hz (High quality, more CPU usage)
• 16-bit, 44100 Hz (CD quality, lower CPU)

**Audio Enhancements:**
Sound settings → Device properties → Enhancements
• Bass Boost - Enhance low frequencies
• Virtual Surround - 3D audio simulation ✓ Recommended
• Loudness Equalization - Consistent volume levels

steps.title: Bang & Olufsen Audio Setup
steps.content:
Your HP OMEN features Bang & Olufsen tuned speakers. Configure them for optimal audio:

1. Open HP Audio Control (pre-installed)

2. Select your audio profile (Music, Movies, Voice, or Custom)

3. Adjust equalizer settings to your preference

4. Enable B&O Audio Enhancement

5. Configure speaker or headphone output

6. Save your custom profile

infoBox.title: Tip
infoBox.content: The B&O audio enhancement includes bass boost and spatial audio features. Experiment with different profiles to find what works best for your content.

steps.title: Gaming Audio Tips
steps.content:
Optimize audio settings specifically for gaming:

**Use Communication Settings:**
Settings → Sound → More sound settings → Communications
Set to "Do nothing" to prevent volume reduction during voice chat

**Disable Exclusive Mode:**
Sound settings → Device properties → Advanced
Uncheck "Allow applications to take exclusive control" for consistent volume

**Set Default Devices:**
Sound settings → More sound settings
Set default playback and communication devices separately

infoBox.title: Important
infoBox.content: Windows Sonic and other spatial audio can interfere with games that have their own 3D audio. Disable spatial sound for games with built-in HRTF or 3D audio support.
